card.name: Diuretic added to blood pressure therapy
card.fires_on: Fires mainly on the ending "tic" of "diuretic" in the sentence saying a diuretic may be added if blood pressure is not controlled by the drug alone. Weaker hits fall on the ends of other drug names or enzyme names in interaction sentences.

modes.label: Diuretic may be added
modes.description: The final piece of "diuretic" in dosing text about adding it when single-drug therapy does not control blood pressure.
